description: Generate (or regenerate) a blog post's hero image, or its OG social card — works the same before and after the post exists. Returns the image inline plus its public URL. The fields below cover prompts, references, style, and the commit:false review flow. Rules that span fields: only the title and subtitle may ever appear on an OG card, because given anything else the generator invents its own tagline; an OG card takes NO references unless you name them, since auto-matching used to put a real face on social cards nobody asked to be in; for target:"og" prompt is the VISUAL DIRECTION and still gets OG framing; to anchor a face, mark the photo as a "headshot" via mark_reference_image first.

accept_asset_id.description: ACCEPT mode, no generation: promote a candidate and attach it. Sets og_image for an OG candidate (og-candidate kind), or featured_image + hero_asset_id for a hero candidate. The field_set key in the response says which field was written.

accept_image_url.description: ACCEPT fallback when only the URL is known — sets featured_image (or og_image when target: "og" is also passed) without asset promotion.

agent.description: Your name, on every write: Duet/<channel name> or Grok Bot/<bot name>.

alt_text.description: ACCEPT mode: override the auto-generated alt text on the accepted asset. Applies to accept_asset_id; ignored on accept_image_url.

caller_name.description: Optional self-reported label for who/what is generating (e.g. an agent name). Shows up in get_hero_history as caller_name — a label you provide, not a verified identity. Omit to default to your account id.

commit.description: Default true: apply the image to the post immediately. False generates a review CANDIDATE (kind hero-candidate) and leaves the post untouched.

domain.description: Site domain to scope this call to (e.g. example.com). Alternative to site_id.

include_subtitle.description: OG only. Default true. False renders a title-only card even when the post has a subtitle.

include_title_text.description: OG only. Default true: render the title as text on the card. False produces a purely visual card.

iteration_prompt.description: Edit instruction for iterating on a previous hero (e.g. "make the background darker"). Requires source_image_url, which anchors composition.

latest_candidate.description: READ mode, no generation: returns the newest un-accepted hero candidate for the post.

prompt.description: Image prompt, auto-generated from the post if omitted. For target:"og", layered on the site share_card_style.

reference_image_ids.description: Curated reference IDs and/or media-library asset IDs (upload_media / list_media). Omitted: reuses the first hero's references, else auto-matches from the prompt. [] uses none.

site_id.description: Site UUID to scope this call to. Alternative to domain.

source_image_url.description: URL of the hero to iterate on (a prior result's image_url). Used with iteration_prompt.

subtitle.description: OG only. Secondary line rendered verbatim beneath the title. Defaults to the post's own subtitle; nothing appears unless passed or stored.

target.description: "hero" (default) sets featured_image; "og" makes the 1200x630 Open Graph card and sets og_image, leaving the hero untouched.
